definitions.gloss: shift system; rotation system; shift work
definitions.explanation: A work schedule system where employees take turns working different time periods, ensuring continuous coverage. Common in factories, hospitals, and service industries.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{交代制|こうたいせい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{稼働|かどう}している→稼働する：19633_kadousuru⟧。
examples.english: This factory operates on a shift system.

examples.japanese: ⟦{看護師|かんごし}→看護師：05055_kangoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三|さん}{交代制|こうたいせい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: The nurses work on a three-shift rotation.

examples.japanese: {交代制|こうたいせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{勤務|きんむ}→勤務：04545_kinmu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦リズム→リズム：04746_rizumu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{崩|くず}れ→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧やすい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難点|なんてん}→難点：15828_nanten⟧だ。
examples.english: The drawback of shift work is that it tends to disrupt your daily rhythm.

notes: Common types: ⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧{交代制|こうたいせい} (two-shift system, typically day and night), {三|さん}{交代制|こうたいせい} (three-shift system, 8 hours each). Common collocations: {交代制|こうたいせい}⟦{勤務|きんむ}→勤務：04545_kinmu⟧ (shift work), {交代制|こうたいせい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ (to work in shifts). The suffix ～⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧ indicates a system or structure: ⟦{会員制|かいいんせい}→会員制：16796_kaiinsei⟧ (membership system), ⟦{予約制|よやくせい}→予約制：07058_yoyakusei⟧ (reservation-only system). Related: ⟦シフト→シフト：10934_shifuto⟧⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧ (shift system — using the English loanword), {当番制|とうばんせい} (duty rotation system).
